lines.t: I walk through the shadow of my own design
A heavy soul burdened by the line I drew
Searching for a light I couldn’t see
Drowning in the silence of my own captivity
And the weight of the world begins to break
Every piece of me I could not save
I look to the sky through the pouring rain
Reaching past the echo of my pain
Hold me now in the arms of grace!
Lift me up from this broken place!
When the dark surrounds and I lose my way
You break the chains and take the sting away!
In Your mercy, I am safe!
[Chorus] (Soaring, Clean Vocals)
Hold me now in the arms of grace!
Lift me up from this broken place!
When the dark surrounds and I lose my way
You break the chains and take the sting away!
In Your mercy, I am safe!
The shadows whisper promises of fear
Trying to convince me You were never near
But truth cuts through the quiet of the night
A gentle voice that calls me to the light
And the weight of the world begins to yield
Every hidden scar is finally healed
I look to the sky through the pouring rain
Reaching past the echo of my pain
[Chorus] (Soaring, Clean Vocals)
Hold me now in the arms of grace!
Lift me up from this broken place!
When the dark surrounds and I lose my way
You break the chains and take the sting away!
In Your mercy, I am safe!
[Bridge] (Dynamic, Melodic Build)
(Melodic Lead Vocal)
No height, no depth, no shadow of doubt
Can pull my heart where Your love isn't found
(Powerful Clean Belt)
From the ashes of who I used to be—
You set me free!
(High Melodic Belt with distantly layered background growl)
YOU SET ME FREE!
[Melodic Guitar Solo]
[Chorus] (Soaring, Full Power Clean Vocals)
Hold me now in the arms of grace!
Lift me up from this broken place!
When the dark surrounds and I lose my way
You break the chains and take the sting away!
In Your mercy, I am safe!
[Outro] (Soft, Fading Clean Vocals)
In Your mercy...
I am safe.
The heavy quiet falls away,
Held forever in Your arms of grace.
Hold me now in the arms of grace!
Lift me up from this broken place!
When the dark surrounds and I lose my way
You break the chains and take the sting away!
In Your mercy, I am safe!
[Outro] (Soft, Fading Clean Vocals)
In Your mercy...
I am safe.
The heavy quiet falls away,
Held forever in Your arms of grace.
